title: Vertex AI passthrough and proxy must be forwarded to the Claude/MaaS delegate, with tracing passed through
answers: Anthropic passthrough /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages returns 400 for a Claude model on Vertex AI
Raw proxy route for a Vertex AI endpoint goes to the public Gemini API with a Vertex token
Vertex AI MaaS model OpenAI passthrough not working in AI Gateway
Token usage missing on span for Claude passthrough on Vertex
body:
Symptom: On a Vertex AI endpoint serving Claude, POST /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages is rejected with 400. On a Vertex endpoint, POST /gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/v1/messages is sent to generativelanguage.googleapis.com.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider forwarded only _chat, _chat_stream, _completions and get_endpoint_url. Passthrough and proxy fell through to the inherited GeminiProvider, whose passthrough actions only cover Gemini.
Fix pattern: VertexAIProvider forwards _passthrough, _proxy and _extract_passthrough_token_usage to self._delegate when a delegate exists, and keeps the Gemini implementation otherwise. Delegates are built with enable_tracing=enable_tracing, because _set_span_token_usage no-ops when the delegate's _enable_tracing is False.
Constraints: Gemini models have no delegate and must keep the Gemini path unchanged. The delegate's own tracing flag must match the outer provider's, or streamed and non-streamed usage never reaches the span.
applies: Changes to VertexAIProvider routing, or to delegate construction in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py.
says: Anthropic API format requests fail with a bad request error for Claude on Vertex.
Proxy requests for Vertex endpoints mistakenly route to the public Gemini service instead.
Tracing spans are missing token usage statistics for Claude calls made through Vertex.
Standard OpenAI passthrough calls fail when accessing partner models hosted on Vertex AI.
Capture token usage on traces while routing passthrough requests to the correct model delegate.
search: VertexAIProvider in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py must forward _passthrough, _proxy, and _extract_passthrough_token_usage calls to self._delegate for Claude and MaaS models instead of falling through to GeminiProvider. Delegates must be instantiated with enable_tracing=enable_tracing matching the outer provider so _set_span_token_usage records token usage onto tracing spans. Gemini models use no delegate and must retain the inherited GeminiProvider routing.
